v.1: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
v.2: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds,
v.4: Master of the Day of Retribution.
v.5: You [alone] do we worship, and to You [alone] do we turn for help.
v.6: Guide us on the straight path,
v.7: the path of those whom You have blessed — such as have not incurred Your wrath, nor are astray.
